title: Varied ARC Session
texts: Easy climbing - 3 sets of climbing on varied wall angles

The goal of this workout is to maintain an increased level of blood flow to the forearms without creating a high level of muscle pump.

Find 3 easy routes, circuits or sections of wall where you can climb for 8 minutes without stopping.  Each set needs to be completed on a different angle. One should be steep, one should be slightly over hanging and one should be vertical.

Climb for 8 minutes at a easy intensity. You should not feel pumped as session intensity is low.  Complete an 8 minute rep once on each angle and rest for 3 minutes between each set.
